flags.message: The provisioned 'brief-in-opposition' document bundles two distinct filings — the Dec 9, 2025 brief in opposition and Intel's Jul 2, 2026 merits response brief — under one document kind, with both source URLs concatenated in documents.json's url field (pipe-separated) and truncated: true across the bundle. The extra merits-brief text was valuable for this briefed-moment cell, but the kind label understates what the file holds, and the petitioners' Apr 23, 2026 merits brief has no counterpart document; a merits-stage document kind would make the provisioning symmetric.
